description: Map a backend directory: every route (method, path, file:line), whether it authenticates, and which tables it reads or writes; plus the tables and their row-level security. Use it to understand a codebase before changing it, and again afterwards to see what the change did to the system's shape.

path.description: Directory to read: the backend's root, absolute or relative to the working directory. Defaults to the working directory.

name: describe_backend
title: Describe backend architecture
